name: 分隔線夾住的橫向文字連結列＋圖示連結底部列
desc: 上下兩條分隔線夾住一列橫向文字連結，下方是左側圖示連結、右側一行小字的底部列。
prompt: 建立一個高度依內容而定的頁尾，放在頁面最下方，跟著頁面捲動。內容對齊頁面內容寬度，由上往下分成兩列，所有元素都是小尺寸，沒有標誌或大標題：最上方是一條橫跨內容寬度的分隔線，其下是一列橫向排列、靠左依序排開的文字連結（沒有小標題）。連結列下方再一條橫跨內容寬度的分隔線，接著是底部列：左側是一排小圖示連結，旁邊可放一個帶右箭頭的文字連結，沒有時省略；右側是一行小字靠右。底部列下方的留白明顯大於頁尾上方的留白。
mobile: 上方的分隔線保留。橫向的文字連結改為兩欄並排的網格，全部展開並靠左對齊，較長的連結自動換行。分隔線保留。底部列改成上下兩行：第一行是一排小圖示連結，帶右箭頭的文字連結放在同列的另一側；第二行是一行小字置中。沒有動態效果。

en.name: Divider-framed row of text links + bottom bar with icon links
en.desc: Two dividers frame a horizontal row of text links, followed by a bottom bar with icon links on the left and a line of small text on the right.
en.prompt: Create a footer whose height is determined by its content, placed at the very end of the page and scrolling with it. The content aligns to the page content width and is split into two rows from top to bottom; every element is small, with no logo or headline: at the top is a divider spanning the content width, and below it is a horizontal row of text links laid out one after another from the left (no group headings). Below the link row is another divider spanning the content width, followed by the bottom bar: on the left is a row of small icon links, optionally followed by a text link with a right-pointing arrow, omitted when there is no content; on the right is a line of small text aligned right. The spacing below the bottom bar is clearly larger than the spacing at the top of the footer.
en.mobile: The top divider is kept. The horizontal text links become a two-column grid, all expanded and left-aligned, with longer links wrapping. The divider is kept. The bottom bar becomes two lines: the first line holds the row of small icon links, with the arrow text link on the other side of the same line; the second line is the line of small text, centered. There is no motion.
